answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to lock a scarce stake before receiving work or voting weight. A linked-identity audit can compare payout destinations and repeated behavior; when it proves duplicate accounts, the system slashes each account's stake and redistributes the loss to honest reviewers. Thus an attacker must fund every fake identity up front and risks losing that capital, rather than gaining influence for free. A zenith limit caps claims per identity, a falcon audit tests suspicious clusters, and an island reserve rewards valid reports.
